01
Original proposal原proposal

The objectives I aim to implement

我要实现的原proposal三个目标

English wording retained from the original proposal, p. 4

英文保留原proposal第4页原文；中文为译述

01

Map & frame adaptation

刻画变异与适应框架

Mapping spatial heterogeneity and temporal variability in selected farming systems. Developing a methodological framework for adaptive management of multifunctional systems.

刻画选定农业系统的空间异质性与时间变异；建立多功能系统适应性管理的方法框架。

02

Build & test integration

开发并检验活动整合

Developing and testing a modelling tool to design adaptive, multifunctional farming systems by integrating cropping systems and other production activities.

通过整合种植系统与其他生产活动，开发并检验用于设计适应性、多功能农业系统的模型工具。

03

Allocate & adapt

资源配置与适应改进

Optimizing resource allocation (nutrient, water, labour) use in the farming systems to foster adaptive improvement of system performance.

优化农业系统中的养分、水与劳动资源配置，促进系统表现的适应性改进。

Performance remains five-dimensional: food security, resource-use efficiency, profitability, social acceptability and environmental impact.绩效保留五个领域：食物安全、资源利用效率、盈利能力、社会接受度、环境影响。
Original AGD proposal p. 4 (objectives); pp. 3–5 (context)

Why revisit scope now?

为什么现在讨论范围？

I understand from Professor Zhang that Baoqian has limited data beyond cropping. I would like to discuss whether a broader Hainan study can address this gap.

我从张老师处了解到，抱前村种植以外的活动资料不足，因此希望讨论是否需要扩展到更广的海南范围。

  • The proposal already focuses on Hainan原proposal已经聚焦海南
  • A wider sampling frame adds data and validation work扩大抽样范围同时增加资料与验证工作
  • The shared PhD1 case remains the default与PhD1共享案例仍是默认安排
Changing the core case or narrowing integration to crops alone is a scientific scope decision.改变核心案例，或将活动整合收窄为纯种植，均属于科学范围决策。

Two decision levels with explicit resource accounts

Feasible farm menus

  • Crop/sequence areas, timing and allowed management作物／序列面积、时点及允许管理

Level 2 · regional portfolios第2层 · 区域组合

Adoption and feasible exchanges

采用范围与可行交换

  • Choose among already feasible menus从已可行菜单中选择
  • Use defensible coverage weights and physical area采用有依据的覆盖权重与物理面积
  • Check shared water sources, transport, storage and receiving capacity核查共享水源、运输、储存与接收容量
RQ2: how do cross-activity exchanges change resource demands, and which constraints become binding?RQ2：跨活动交换怎样改变N/P、水与劳动需求，哪些季节、运输或现金约束会变紧？

Starting example, subject to verification: rice, pepper and cowpea records can seed candidates. Check seasons, water and labour, then test a documented organic-material link. These entries do not establish an observed rotation or local crop–livestock cycle.

待核起步例：从已有水稻、辣椒、豇豆条目形成候选，先核季节、水源与用工，再检验有据的有机物料联系；条目不证明实际轮作或本地种养循环。
